experimental_authenticity.signal: Spectrophotometric NADH/NADPH consumption or production, directly or with coupling enzymes, at experimentally varied substrate concentrations
experimental_authenticity.not_teacher_labels: The experiments are described independently of the paper's downstream network model. SBML simulations, flux-control coefficients and model-predicted metabolite/flux values are not accepted as observations.
experimental_authenticity.not_raw: Table 2 parameters are reductions of these experiments through specified kinetic fits, not raw concentration-rate observations.

enzyme_preparation.native_context_qualification: Yeast-expressed tagged proteins, generally overexpressed or chromosomally tagged; purified in vitro, not intact-cell physiological rates or unmodified endogenous preparations.
enzyme_preparation.expression_control: GAL1-inducible promoter for overexpression constructs; tag placement varied when required for enzyme function.
composition_checks: SDS-PAGE of intermediate and final preparations
enzyme_preparation.amount_blocker: A method for quantifying purified protein is documented, but no per-assay enzyme concentration was verified. The 5 microlitre enzyme addition is a volume, not an enzyme amount.
enzyme_preparation.special_case: Pfk1 and Pfk2 were co-expressed and co-purified as the active heterooctamer after individual-subunit preparations proved unsuitable. The complex is one assay target, not two independent observations.

input_conditions_verified.pH_status: Not stated in the inspected main-text assay section; obtain the source-linked detailed protocol before use.
input_conditions_verified.calibration_warning: The inspected source prints 6.62. Do not silently replace it with a conventional NADH coefficient; confirm the actual calibration and optical path from the instrument/protocol record.
independently_controlled_inputs: Substrate concentration in each enzyme titration
Reaction direction where forward and reverse assays were possible
input_conditions_verified.independent_regulator_matrix: Not established; substrate titration is not evidence that a regulator was crossed independently with substrate.
input_conditions_verified.allocation_randomization: Not reported in the inspected methods
input_conditions_verified.controls: Parallel background-activity controls and adjustment of coupling-enzyme concentrations to make the target reaction rate-limiting are described; control record IDs and calibration uncertainty are missing.

author_repository.access_method: gh API metadata/tree only; no cloning or execution
author_repository.finding: The inspected tree contains Java/software resources and SQL schema, not an assay observation archive. Source code or a database schema is not experimental data.

historical_raw_repository_lead.ancestry_warning: This is the same research/software pipeline, not an independent validation study. No exact mapping from these 2010 example records to 2013 assay records was verified.

source_modeling_and_normalization_histor: Background correction precedes initial-rate estimation; exact blank files and extraction windows were not retrieved.
Initial rates at varied substrates were fitted by KineticsWizard to Michaelis-Menten kinetics. Tpi1 substrate-inhibited data were analysed with COPASI using a supplied inhibition law.

The network model was iteratively revised using flux-control analysis to prioritize experimental characterization. Source-model outputs and model-refitted parameters cannot become independent reaction truth.
Purified protein quantification is distinct from active enzyme fraction; published kcat labels do not establish intrinsic in-vivo turnover or native active abundance.

Separate QconCAT proteomics/metabolomics in this paper do not independently calibrate the active fraction of each purified assay preparation. Source iteration/parameter lineage must be audited before any use as validation.

reserved_labels_and_support.potential_reservation: Unexposed complete preparation/day assays or, only under a new conditional-assay protocol, genuinely randomized reaction units with preparation-aware inference. Source records and allocation evidence are required first.
reserved_labels_and_support.support_limit: Protein presence and whole-pathway metabolite consistency are not orthogonal validation of a catalytic response law. No independent pyruvate/product-formation rate assay in matched conditions was verified.

decision: Scientifically promising direct substrate-response source, but raw data access, preparation/unit/randomization/validation inventory and new registration are blocking. No fitting authorized.
